nodes.label: FRONTEND_MODELS.md: view models and simulated data
View models belong to the frontend
nodes.rationale: They describe what a screen paints, not what the backend stores. DTO to VM adapters live in lib/adapters/, so the backend does not adopt these types.

nodes.label: Modelling conventions: ISO dates, number formatting, literal unions, optional fields, Lucide icon names
Stable domain-prefixed IDs: usr-, cmp-, srv-, crs-, crd-
slug and username: a-z0-9-, 3 to 30 characters; may change, id does not
nodes.rationale: An old username stops existing (DEC-017).

nodes.label: Public view models never contain private fields
nodes.rationale: Holds even when the private fields are empty.

nodes.label: Company read services: getCompanies and getCompanyBySlug
nodes.rationale: Return a VM or null; null leads to notFound(). They throw on error.

nodes.label: Read service getPublicProfile(username)
Simulated write service saveProfile returns Simulated
nodes.rationale: Never persists outside the browser.

nodes.label: Block B profile services in lib/services/profiles.ts
nodes.rationale: getProfileForViewer, getProfileForm, getPreviewCard, getAccountSettings, saveProfile, saveAccountSettings.

nodes.label: Server actions saveOwnProfile and saveOwnSettings in lib/actions/profile.ts
nodes.rationale: Both call the service and require a session.

nodes.label: Session type: userId, username, displayName, roles (lib/session.ts)
nodes.rationale: Demo user usr-lucia-martin with roles talent and admin.

nodes.label: Role union: talent, company, admin
SignupFormVM: fullName 2 to 80, email, password of 8 or more, acceptsTerms required
nodes.rationale: intent is talent only; the company option is disabled until block G (DEC-022). The password is never stored in fixtures or storage.

nodes.label: AccountSettingsVM: email, verification, visibility, notification toggles
ProfileVisibility: private or public
nodes.rationale: No more levels until legal answers (DEC-015).

nodes.label: PublicProfileVM: private variant (username only) or full public profile
nodes.rationale: The private variant carries no other data (DEC-012). The public variant lists interests, skills (self-declared, never verified), experience, education, issued credentials and isOwner.

nodes.label: ExperienceVM: role, organization, start, end, description
EducationVM: title, institution, start, end
ProfileFormVM: editable profile fields
OnboardingVM: four steps, completed list, partial draft
nodes.rationale: Steps: about you, education and experience, interests, privacy.

nodes.label: ProfileCompletionVM: percent and missing sections
ProfileViewVM (implemented): union by kind, private or full
ProfileCardVM: form plus username, what a person with the link sees
Simulated type: { simulated: true }, result of every simulated write
Block B implementation differs from the proposal
nodes.rationale: ProfileFormVM has no visibility (it is account data). Start dates are optional. ProfileViewVM is a union by kind. Session and Role live in lib/models/session.ts. SESSION_COOKIE is bw_demo.

nodes.label: Month values AAAA-MM, formatted with fixed month names instead of Intl
nodes.rationale: So server and browser render the same text.

nodes.label: CompanyCardVM: id, slug, name, category, description, logo, cover, up to 5 stats
nodes.rationale: Already exists as Company in data/mock.ts; renamed on migration (C-01).

nodes.label: CompanyDetailVM: website, followers, isFollowing, modules, sources, staleness
nodes.rationale: website and followersCount only when real (BE-025). isFollowing reflects the current session (C-05). isStale when lastReviewedAt is over 180 days (DEC-020).

nodes.label: CompanyModuleKind: open list of six module kinds
nodes.rationale: summary, culture, programs, openings, locations, sources (DEC-020).

nodes.label: CompanyModuleVM: kind, title, body, items
SourceVM: label, url, retrievedAt
EditorialStatus: draft, in-review, changes-requested, published, archived
AdminCompanyRowVM: admin table row for a company
ReviewItemVM: company profile edit awaiting review
SurveyStatus: open, upcoming, closed
SurveyParticipation: not-started, in-progress, completed
Eligibility: follows, interested, not-eligible, unknown
nodes.rationale: Survey audience: people who follow the company or are interested in it (DEC-016, open point OI-017).

nodes.label: SurveySummaryVM: survey card with publisher, timing, participation, eligibility
nodes.rationale: The publisher CLH is company cmp-clh (DEC-016).

nodes.label: SurveyDetailVM: intro, consent, privacy note, sections
SurveySectionVM: titled group of questions
SurveyQuestionVM: five question types (single, multiple, scale, short-text, long-text)
nodes.rationale: Scale allows min 1 and max 5, 7 or 10 with end labels; text questions have maxLength.

nodes.label: SurveyAnswersVM: answers keyed by question id, draft in sessionStorage
CourseFormat: online, hybrid, in-person
CourseStatus: open, upcoming, closed
CourseSummaryVM: course card with format, duration, topics, credential flag
CourseDetailVM: description, outcomes, syllabus, enrollment (interest-only or external url)
nodes.rationale: The external url appears only when it is real.

nodes.label: CredentialVM: issuer, issue date, optional evidence link, no verified seal
nodes.rationale: Issuer and date only, no 'verificada' seal (DEC-021).

nodes.label: PublicStatsVM: landing figures; a missing figure is not painted
TalentDashboardVM: greeting, completion, next step, surveys, courses, companies
nodes.rationale: nextStep is the only primary button. Companies are chosen by interests, with no matching.

nodes.label: Simulated dataset: one coherent universe with stable IDs and slugs
Fixture rules: example markers, no real people, no invented URLs, hex colours only in fixtures
nodes.rationale: Figures in fixtures are marked as examples. website, evidenceUrl and enrollment.url are omitted when not real. Mock logos are SVG generated in mock.ts.

nodes.label: Fixture profiles (B-03): lucia-martin public complete, marcos-gil private, ana-ruiz partial
Fixture companies (C-01): nine mock companies, cmp-clh, one draft for the 404, one stale
Fixture follows (C-05): lucia-martin follows three companies including cmp-clh
Fixture surveys (E-01): six surveys across statuses, all five question types
nodes.rationale: Open, in progress, completed, upcoming, closed, not eligible. At least one published by cmp-clh.

nodes.label: Fixture landing stats (A-08): four example figures
Fixture courses (E-04): six courses in three formats
Fixture credentials (E-04): two for lucia-martin, none for ana-ruiz
Fixture editorial reviews (F-04): three company profile submissions
Adapter toCompanyDetailVM: pure DTO to VM mapping
nodes.rationale: Unit test once tests exist (X-02).

nodes.label: Adapter rules: one per VM, pure, document fallbacks
nodes.rationale: isStale and ProfileCompletionVM.percent are computed in the frontend unless the backend provides them.

nodes.label: DEC-010: only issued credentials appear on the public profile
DEC-011: id never changes; slug and username may change
DEC-012: private profile exposes nothing beyond the username
DEC-015: only private and public visibility until legal answers
DEC-016: survey audience is followers or interested people
DEC-017: an old username stops existing
DEC-020: company modules are an open list; stale after 180 days
DEC-021: credentials show issuer and date, no verified seal
DEC-022: company signup option disabled until block G
OI-017: audience definition for survey eligibility
BE-025: backend follower count, needed before followersCount is shown
